name: claudes-babysitter
description: Claude's Babysitter — keeps AI code generators inside a product's UI system: AST lint rules, static WCAG contrast of theme tokens, component-reuse audit, Claude Code + git hooks and Playwright micro-checks. Enforces the UI Architecture & Consistency Guidelines (58 recurring UI bug patterns).

scripts.test: npm run test:eslint && npm run test:stylelint && npm run test:check && npm run test:tt && npm run test:team && npm run test:acceptance && npm run test:run && npm run test:content && npm run test:layout && npm run test:studio && npm run test:forms && npm run test:fp && npm run test:misses && npm run test:issues && npm run test:misses550 && npm run test:update && npm run test:package
scripts.test:check: node test/ui-check.test.mjs && node test/audit-safety.test.mjs && node test/route-map.test.mjs && node test/checks-runtime.test.mjs && node test/checks-fp.test.mjs
scripts.test:tt: node test/time-travel.test.mjs && node test/tool-failure.test.mjs && node test/proposals.test.mjs
scripts.test:run: for f in test/run-*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:content: node test/content-lint.test.mjs && node test/content-consistency.test.mjs && node test/content-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test:misses: node test/misses.test.mjs && node test/misses-520.test.mjs && node test/misses-521.test.mjs && node test/stage.test.mjs
scripts.test:misses550: for f in layout-a layout-b content-a content-b money states; do node test/misses-550-$f.test.mjs || exit 1; done
